eps.ov: In a realm which exists right next to reality but no ordinary people can see, there is the "Magician’s Academy" – the school for today's wizards and witches who live between the realms, hiding their true identities while they are among us. Takuto Hasegawa looks like a high school boy who embodies the word "ordinary" in every sense, but he is actually a wizard in the making who secretly attends the Academy.

eps.t: Somehow, What You're Doing Became a Serious Case.

eps.t: We Somehow Even Got a Demon Lord Coming Out
eps.ov: With Takuto injured, it's up to Tanarotte to save the day!
